transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um... my sister told me I needed to come. I guess... my body just feels kind of out of my control lately. Like, at first I was just pacing around my apartment all night, making all these supper-club notes. But lately... I don't know. I'm just really slowed down. She says it takes me forever just to get my shoes on. So... yeah.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is there?
Um... no. I haven't heard anything like that.
Have you had a time recently when your mood felt unusually high or irritable?

Um... I guess maybe a little of both. 

Like... after I got fired recently, I didn't feel bad about it. I actually felt... I don't know, weirdly unstoppable. Just really excited. But... yeah, if anyone questioned my plans or... or told me to slow down, I kind of blew up at them. It just felt like they were trying to ruin my life. So... yeah.
Have you believed something that other people said wasn’t true, but you were sure it was?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. I mean, people disagree about stuff, but... I haven't believed anything crazy. Just normal things.
Have you had a period recently when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... I guess I've had some down days, but... not every day. Just normal stuff.
Have you ever had a time when your mood was so high or irritable that it lasted at least a week?
Um... a week? I don't know... maybe? I don't really keep track of the days like that. It just... it lasted a while, I guess. I didn't really time it.
During that energized period, did it get so severe that you couldn't function normally at work, socially, or take care of yourself?

Um... yeah, I guess. Things kind of... fell apart. Like, work and rent... family stuff. I just couldn't keep it all together. It got to where... my sister actually had to take me to a crisis clinic. I just... I couldn't really organize anything on my own.
For at least two weeks recently, have you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
Um... didn't you just ask me that? I... no. Not for two weeks straight. Just... like I said before, just some normal down days. Nothing like that.
